ev.q: During 2011–2013, male veterans aged 25–74 years were more likely to consume an average of ≥15 alcoholic drinks per week
Among men aged 25–34 years, the proportion of veterans who were heavy drinkers was 9%, higher than the 6% observed in nonveterans.
During 2011–2013, veterans accounted for 18% of the male population aged 25–74 years
veterans were more likely than nonveterans to be heavy drinkers among men aged 55–64 years (7% versus 5%)
There was no significant difference in the proportion of veterans compared with nonveterans who were heavy drinkers among men aged 35–44 years
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the noninstitutionalized U.S. civilian population
